settings.title: Settings
settings.hide_to_tray_on_game_launch: Hide to tray while a game is running

settings.save_correlation_tooltip: Also treats a file written at the very same moment as a known save path as a save. Finds save folders whose name has nothing to do with the game, but can pick up unrelated files.
settings.save_correlation_window_tooltip: Largest gap allowed between the two writes. Weaker candidates get 40% of it.
settings.min_kept_backups_tooltip: Minimum number of most recent backups to always keep, even if older than retention period. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.backup_on_exit_tooltip: Automatically create a full backup when a tracked game closes
settings.auto_scan_on_exit_tooltip: Enable live detection of save files during gameplay and confirmation of found paths on exit. Paths detected in real time are also used for automatic periodic backups.

settings.game_suppressions_hint: Games where you chose "don't show again" for a specific notification (e.g. automatic backup). Remove to re-enable.

settings.excluded_paths_hint: Paths deleted during save confirmation (live tracking, auto-detect, general/extended scan). Restoring them lets a later scan find and propose them again.

settings.launch_on_startup_tooltip: Start SaveSync with the system, so games are watched from the first launch.
settings.minimize_to_tray_tooltip: Closing the window leaves SaveSync running in the tray instead of quitting.
settings.auto_sync_after_backup_tooltip: Upload every new backup to your cloud provider as soon as it is made.
settings.show_overlay_on_launch_tooltip: Show the in-game overlay when a tracked game starts.
settings.show_overlay_on_unknown_tooltip: Show a notification when an unknown process is detected.
settings.show_overlay_on_cloud_tooltip: Show the overlay when cloud saves are available for the game you just started.
settings.show_overlay_on_backup_tooltip: Show the overlay when a backup finishes.
settings.max_backups_tooltip: How many backups to keep per game. The oldest are deleted beyond this.
settings.backup_retention_tooltip: Backups older than this are deleted — unless they fall under the minimum kept.
settings.max_size_mb_tooltip: Save folders bigger than this are skipped instead of backed up.
settings.save_hints_tooltip: Folder names that mark a save location. One per line; matching is case-insensitive.
settings.backup_verify_tooltip: Opens each backup in the background and confirms it is still readable and complete, so a damaged one is found before you need it.
settings.backup_verify_interval_tooltip: How often the check runs. It starts a few minutes after launch, never while a game is being backed up.
settings.save_edit_copies_tooltip: How many copies of one save file the editor keeps before the oldest is dropped. A copy is taken every time you write to a save, so this is how far back an edit can be undone.
settings.save_edit_copy_days_tooltip: Copies older than this are removed. The newest is always kept, however old it is, so there is always something to undo with.

manual_path.title: Add save folders
manual_path.description: Register save folders for backup by hand, even with no executable behind them. An absolute path, or one under your user folder, is taken literally; a relative path is looked for among known game locations.
manual_path.add_multiple_tooltip: Pick the folder that collects your saves — it can be named anything. Each subfolder is a game, and what it contains says where those saves belong.
manual_path.pick_parent: Select the folder that collects the saves
manual_path.multiple_added: {count} folders added — check the name and path of each.
manual_path.empty: No folders yet. Use Add one or Add several.
manual_path.verdict_actual_missing: ⚠  Actual path, but it does not exist yet: {path}
manual_path.verdict_dest_here: ✓  The saves are in this folder
manual_path.verdict_predicted: ⚠  Destination relative to the game, not located on disk yet. It is registered and anchored on its own once the game turns up.
manual_path.none_resolved: No path resolved to an existing folder: fix the paths or use Browse.
manual_path.collection_hint: The collection folder can have any name: only one level below it is read. Each subfolder identifies the game and IS the backup source — the saves are right there. The structure inside it is only read and recorded: it is the destination path, the one needed to put them back into the game. When it starts at a user folder (Roaming, LocalLow…) that destination is already known on this machine and is used directly.
manual_path.result_not_yet: {count} destinations do not exist yet: registered anyway, ready for a restore.
